scope.statement: For two distinct final Section-50.1 components with fixed linear-size direction subsets in arcs of radius epsilon and center separation s=|sin(phi_1-phi_2)|>2 epsilon, prove V_AB >= alpha beta (s-2 epsilon)D^2-C_delta D^(2-eta), conditional on sum_e delta_e <= C_delta D.
scope.domain: Exact PR #103 analytic implication for a finite pure simply connected strict-rhombic disk, fixed eta and lambda, its train-crossing graph, high-defect-first deletion, and iterative low-degree vertex pruning.
scope.limitations: Does not establish the supplied total-defect estimate, separated angular-subset extraction, the global zonotope identity, shell transfer, global minimality, or Level I. The arithmetic verifier checks formulas and scale controls only.

result: Independent audit passes the supplied-hypothesis inequality. The pruning-edge term is excluded because both endpoints of a cross-component edge survive; the angular determinant bound follows from the 1-Lipschitz property of |sin|. A fixed lambda and positive epsilon also give a linear angular cluster in each component by finite binning, but not separated centers.
remaining_questions: Derive or obstruct two retained angular clusters whose centers satisfy |sin(phi_1-phi_2)|>2 epsilon under the canonical shell hypotheses, with constants suitable for fixed-lambda MCP2.
Show how a resulting V_AB term enters the exact Target B shell inequality without cancellation by support depth, or construct the full source-preserving strict sub-D competitor.
